# v0.4.0 - Release Notes

### Added

- **All 5 MVP box types** — countdown (days-until), weather (temp/condition/H-L), QR (real generation via qrcode-generator), quote (wrapped text + author), text (existing)
- **Spleen 8x16 hero font** — purpose-designed bitmap font embedded in renderer for hero numbers (temperatures, times, day counts)
- **Hero + whitespace design** — all box renderers updated with hero font, thin rules, whitespace padding (no more box borders)
- **Dual-display type system** — `displayId: 'D' | 'P'` on BentoConfig. D = phone-mounted (real-time), P = counter/peek (ambient)
- **Web editor** — vanilla JS with reactive state, D/P display toggle, client-side 1-bit canvas rendering, localStorage persistence, JSON import/export
- **128x296 portrait resolution** — standard 2.9" eInk panel rotated 90°. Frame buffer drops to 4736 bytes
- **Hardware design** — dual eInk back-to-back, 180° hinge, battery on solar half, OpenSCAD mockup + STL, GPIO pin allocation, physical mode diagrams

### Changed

- Form factor: 320° cam-follower → 180° standard friction hinge ($1-8 vs $15-30)
- Battery: display half → solar half (avoids grip flex degradation)
- Price: $25 → $30 (BOM-validated)
- Thickness: ~8mm → ~7.2mm folded (3.2mm display + 4.0mm solar)
- Preview pipeline: custom drawing → real `render()` calls

### Stats

- 63 tests across 9 test files
- 28 commits since v0.3.0
- 5 box types, 2 font sizes, 2 displays, 3 physical modes
